hindi: दुर्ग और राष्ट्र में कण्टक-शोधन कहा जा चुका है।
english: The removal of thorns in the fort and the country has been stated.
notes: kaṇṭaka-śodhana is literally 'removal of thorns'. The dual durga-rāṣṭrayoḥ is taken as locative ('in'); a genitive ('of fort and country') is also possible.

hindi: राजा और राज्य के विषय में हम कहेंगे।
english: In the case of the king and the kingdom we shall state [it].
notes: The object is not expressed; it is the removal of thorns of unit 1 (supplied in brackets in English only).

words.gloss: support of the party of the seducible

hindi: जो मुख्य राजा को रोककर जीविका चलाने वाले हैं, अथवा जो शत्रु के साथ साझे के हैं, उनके विषय में गूढ़ पुरुषों का प्रयोग अथवा कृत्य-पक्ष को सहारा देना सिद्धि है, जैसा पहले कहा गया है; उपजाप अथवा गुप्तचर, जैसा हम पारग्रामिक में कहेंगे।
english: As for those chiefs who live [off him] having restrained the king, or who are shared with the enemy: in their case the deployment of secret agents, or the support of the party of the seducible, [brings] success, as stated before; [or] secret instigation or a spy, as we shall state in the Pāragrāmika.
notes: avagṛhya (ava-√grah) is rendered 'having restrained'; 'having seized' is the alternative, and the object of upajīvinaḥ is not stated ('[off him]' is supplied). pāragrāmike is left as a name: the text seems to name a later section, but the e-text gives no more and no identification is made. siddhiḥ has no verb; '[brings]' is supplied in English only. 'Success' follows the glossary.

hindi: जो मुख्य राज्य को हानि पहुँचाने वाले, वल्लभ अथवा संगठित हैं और खुले रूप से जिन्हें रोकना सम्भव नहीं, वे दूष्य हैं; उनके विषय में धर्म में रुचि रखने वाला गुप्त दण्ड का प्रयोग करे।
english: But those chiefs who harm the kingdom, [being] favourites or united, and who cannot be restrained openly, [are] the treasonable; against them one who is fond of dharma should apply secret punishment.
notes: '[are]' and the copula in Hindi are supplied. dharma-ruciḥ: literally 'having dharma as his liking'. upāṃśu-daṇḍa = secret punishment (glossary).

words.gloss: brother of a treasonable high official

hindi: गुप्तचर दूष्य महामात्र के उस भाई को, जिसके साथ बुरा बर्ताव हुआ हो, उकसाकर राजा को दिखलाए।
english: A secret agent, having incited the ill-treated brother of a treasonable high official, should present [him] to the king.
notes: mahā-mātra = high official (glossary 12.2; 12.3 has 'high officer'). asat-kṛta is literally 'badly done to / not honoured'; 'ill-treated' chosen. darśayet is literally 'should cause to see'. dūṣya-mahā-mātra is taken as a karmadhāraya (treasonable high official).

words.gloss: by granting the enjoyment of the treasonable one's property

hindi: राजा उसे दूष्य की सम्पत्ति का उपभोग प्रदान करके दूष्य पर आक्रमण कराए।
english: The king should make him attack the treasonable one by granting [him] the enjoyment of the treasonable one's property.
notes: atisarga = granting, giving away. dravya = property, goods. '[him]' is supplied in English only.

hindi: आक्रमण करने वाले को वहीं शस्त्र अथवा विष से मरवा दे — "यह भाई का हत्यारा है।"
english: [He] should have the one who has attacked killed right there, by weapon or poison, [with the words]: "This is a brother-killer."
notes: rasa = poison (glossary); 'liquid' is the plain alternative. The subject (the king) is not stated. The closing iti is not translated.

hindi: इससे पारशव तथा परिचारिका के पुत्र की व्याख्या हुई।
english: By that, the pāraśava and the son of a female servant are explained.
notes: pāraśava is kept as a term: in the dharma literature the word is used of the son of a śūdra woman, but the line itself gives no definition. 'By that' refers back to the procedure of units 5-7 (reading of the sentence, not stated in the text). Literal 'explained' kept.

hindi: अथवा गुप्तचर से उकसाया गया भाई दूष्य महामात्र से दाय माँगे।
english: Or the brother, incited by a secret agent, should ask the treasonable high official for a share.

text_flags.why: possible: the anusvāra before the compound dot and the joined 'mahāmātra' look irregular; elsewhere the compound is dūṣya.mahā.mātra. If the dot is a typo for a space ('dūṣyaṃ mahāmātraṃ vā') the sense would be 'the treasonable one or the high official'.

notes: Read as a compound 'treasonable high official' as in units 5, 14, 15. Alternative (if the text means two persons): 'from the treasonable one or the high official'. dāya = share / inheritance (glossary uses dāya in the later units).

words.gloss: at the door of the treasonable one's house

words.gram: pres. part. ātm. m. acc. sg. upa-√śī

hindi: रात में दूष्य के घर के द्वार पर सोते हुए, अथवा अन्यत्र रहते हुए उसे जो तीक्ष्ण मारने वाला हो, वह कहे — "दाय चाहने वाला यह मारा गया।"
english: The assassin who kills him—while he is sleeping at night at the door of the treasonable one's house, or staying elsewhere—should say: "This one, desirous of a share, is killed."
notes: Syntax: 'tam ... upaśayānam ... vasantam' is the object of hantā ('killer'), and tīkṣṇo hantā brūyāt is rendered 'the assassin who kills him ... should say'. pratidvāri is taken as 'at the door' (adverbial); the form is not common.

hindi: तब मारे गए के पक्ष को सहारा देकर दूसरे का निग्रह करे।
english: Then, having supported the party of the slain [man], he should suppress the other.
notes: 'the other' is the other party, the treasonable one; the text does not name him.

words.gram: pres. part. ātm. m. acc. sg. √yāc

hindi: अथवा दूष्य के समीप स्थित गुप्तचर दाय माँगते हुए भाई को वध की धमकी दें।
english: Or secret agents stationed near the treasonable one should threaten with killing the brother who is asking for a share.
notes: ghāta is 'killing' or 'a blow'; 'with killing' chosen.

hindi: "उसे रात में" — यह समान है।
english: "Him at night"—[this] is the same [as before].
notes: Elliptical cross-reference: the words taṃ rātrau recall the opening of unit 10 and the sense is that the procedure there applies; the line gives no more. 'iti' closes the quoted catchwords and is not rendered 'thus'. '[as before]' is supplied in English only.

words.gloss: with a kāpaṭika at its head

hindi: अथवा दूष्य महामात्रों में जो पुत्र पिता की स्त्रियों के पास जाता है, या पिता पुत्र की स्त्रियों के पास, या भाई भाई की, उन दोनों का कापटिक-मुख कलह पहले वाले से व्याख्यात है।
english: Or of treasonable high officials: if a son approaches [the wives] of his father, or a father the wives of his son, or a brother [those] of a brother, the quarrel between those two, with a kāpaṭika at its head, is explained by the earlier [rule].
notes: The dual dūṣya-mahā-mātrayoḥ is read loosely as 'of treasonable high officials'. The objects after pituḥ and bhrātuḥ are understood from dārān (supplied in brackets in English). adhicarati is rendered literally 'approaches'; the text clearly means an improper approach but the line does not say so. kāpaṭika-mukha: kāpaṭika is kept as a term (a deceitful person/agent); 'at its head' is literal for -mukha; alternatives possible. pūrveṇa: 'by the earlier' (the earlier passage on quarrels, units 5-13).

words.gloss: son of a treasonable high official

hindi: गुप्तचर दूष्य महामात्र के पुत्र को, अथवा अपने द्वारा सम्मानित को, "तुम राजपुत्र हो, शत्रु के भय से यहाँ रखे गए हो" — ऐसा कहकर गुप्त रूप से उकसाए।
english: A secret agent should instigate secretly the son of a treasonable high official, or one esteemed by himself: "You are a king's son; from fear of the enemy you have been placed here."
notes: ātma-sambhāvita is literally 'esteemed/ honoured by himself'; 'self-conceited' is an alternative reading. upa-√jap is literally 'whisper to'; 'instigate secretly' follows the glossary upajāpa. In Hindi the connecting 'ऐसा कहकर' makes the quotation link to the verb and renders no extra 'iti' sense.

words.gloss: for whom the time of heir-apparentship has come
from fear of the high officials

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने वाले को राजा एकान्त में सम्मानित करे — "तुम्हारे लिए युवराज-पद का समय आ गया है, महामात्रों के भय से मैं तुम्हारा अभिषेक नहीं करता।"
english: The king should honour in private the one who has accepted [it]: "For you, for whom the time of heir-apparentship has come, I do not anoint [you] from fear of the high officials."
notes: pratipannam = the one who has accepted (glossary), here the claim of unit 15 ('[it]' supplied). yauvarājya = the position of yuva-rāja (heir-apparent). number of mahā-mātra is not marked in the compound ('officials').

words.gloss: in the killing of the high officials

hindi: गुप्तचर उसे महामात्रों के वध में लगाए।
english: The secret agent should engage him in the killing of the high officials.
notes: mahā-mātra-vadhe: the number of the compound's first member is not marked ('high official' or 'officials').

hindi: आक्रमण करने वाले को वहीं मरवा दे — "यह पिता का हत्यारा है।"
english: [He] should have the one who has attacked killed right there, [with the words]: "This is a father-killer."
notes: Subject (the king) not stated, as in unit 7.

hindi: अथवा भिक्षुकी दूष्य की पत्नी को वशीकरण की औषधियों से साथ बसाकर विष से छले।
english: Or a female mendicant, having made the wife of the treasonable one live together [with her] by love-winning herbs, should outwit [her] with poison.
notes: saṃvāsya is literally 'having made [her] live together'; the object of the togetherness is not stated ('[with her]' is only a possible filling), so confidence is medium. atisandadhyāt = 'should outwit' (glossary atisaṃhita = outwitted); who is outwitted is not stated. sāṃvadanikī oṣadhī = love-winning herb (glossary).

hindi: — यह आप्य का प्रयोग है।
english: — such is the application of āpya.
notes: āpya is obscure here (literally 'to be obtained', from ā-√āp); no sense is invented. Possibly a technical label for the preceding procedures. The opening iti sums up the preceding procedure ('such is'), not rendered 'thus'.

words.gloss: to be conveyed across with a caravan
with what is to be taken back

hindi: दूष्य महामात्र को दुर्बल सेना और तीक्ष्णों से युक्त करके भेजे — आटवी या शत्रु के गाँव को मारने के लिए, या कान्तार से व्यवहित प्रदेश में राष्ट्रपाल अथवा अन्तपाल को स्थापित करने के लिए, या कुपित नागर-स्थान को रोकने के लिए, या सार्थ द्वारा पार पहुँचाए जाने योग्य को लेने के लिए, या सीमा पर प्रत्यादेय सहित को लेने के लिए।
english: [The king] should send the treasonable high official, with weak troops and accompanied by assassins, to strike down the forest tribes or an enemy village; or to install a country-warden or a frontier officer in a region separated by a wilderness; or to restrain the angered town-station; or to take [what is] to be conveyed across [with] a caravan; or, at the frontier, [what is] with what is to be taken back.
notes: Several terms are obscure and rendered literally: nāgara-sthāna (literally 'town-station'; 'city or fort' is a possible alternative); sārtha-ativāhya (literally 'to be conveyed across with a caravan'; sārtha could also be read as 'with property'); sa-pratyādeya (literally 'with what is to be taken back'). The last two phrases are not clear in sense. aṭavī = forest tribes per glossary (literally 'forest'). kupita = angered (rebellious is a possible sense). avagrāhitum is the same root as avagṛhya in unit 3 (restrain). The subject (the king) is not stated.

words.gloss: agents in the guise of robbers

hindi: रात या दिन में युद्ध छिड़ जाने पर तीक्ष्ण अथवा प्रतिरोधक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर उसे मार डालें — "आक्रमण में मारा गया।"
english: When battle has begun, by night or by day, assassins or agents in the guise of robbers should kill [him]: "Killed in the attack."
notes: The object (the treasonable high official sent out in unit 21) is not stated. pratirodhaka = robber (glossary 8.4).

words.gloss: gone on a journey or pleasure outing

hindi: अथवा यात्रा या विहार पर गया हुआ दूष्य महामात्रों को दर्शन के लिए बुलाए।
english: Or, [the king] having gone on a journey or a pleasure outing, should summon the treasonable high officials for an audience.
notes: The subject is not stated; the king is understood. vihāra = amusement (glossary 8.4). darśana is literally 'seeing', here a meeting/audience.

words.gloss: for the purpose of entering inside

hindi: वे छिपे शस्त्रों वाले तीक्ष्णों के साथ बीच की कक्ष्या में प्रवेश करके भीतर प्रवेश करने के लिए अपनी तलाशी दें।
english: They, having entered the middle enclosure together with assassins [carrying] concealed weapons, should give a search of themselves for the purpose of entering inside.
notes: 'They' are the treasonable high officials summoned in unit 23. kakṣyā = enclosure / courtyard of a palace (literal); the middle one is the second of the successive enclosures. ātma-vicaya = 'search of oneself' (submitting to a search).

hindi: तब द्वारपालों से पकड़े गए तीक्ष्ण कहें — "हम दूष्यों द्वारा लगाए गए हैं।"
english: Then the assassins, seized by the door-keepers, should say: "We have been employed by the treasonable ones."
notes: The printed 'sma' is smaḥ with the visarga lost before iti (sandhi), so no text flag. dauvārika is literally 'door-keeper'; number not marked.

hindi: वे उसे प्रसिद्ध करके दूष्यों को मार डालें।
english: They, having made that known, should kill the treasonable ones.
notes: 'They' is not identified in the line (probably the king's men who have seized the assassins); 'that' is the assassins' statement of unit 25.

words.gloss: in the place of the assassins

hindi: और तीक्ष्णों के स्थान पर दूसरे वध्य हैं।
english: And in the place of the assassins others are to be killed.
notes: The sense of 'others in the place of the assassins' is not spelled out in the line (substitutes in their stead); rendered literally.

words.gloss: gone on an outside pleasure outing

hindi: अथवा बाहर विहार के लिए गया हुआ निकट निवास वाले दूष्यों का सम्मान करे।
english: Or, [the king] having gone on a pleasure outing outside, should honour the treasonable ones whose dwellings are near.
notes: Subject (the king) is not stated. bahir.vihāra is read 'outside amusement/outing'.

words.gloss: in the guise of a queen

hindi: उनके निवासों में रात को रानी के वेश वाली दुष्ट स्त्री पकड़ी जाए — यह पहले के समान है।
english: Or a bad woman in the guise of a queen should be caught in their dwellings at night—[this is] the same as the earlier [procedure].
notes: devī is literally 'goddess', here a queen (royal consort). duḥstrī is literally 'bad woman'. The closing iti marks the end of the rule and is not rendered 'thus'. The earlier procedure is the night scene of units 10-12. '[this is]' supplied in English only.

hindi: अथवा दूष्य महामात्र से "तुम्हारा रसोइया अथवा भक्ष-कार उत्तम है" इस प्रकार स्तुति करके भक्ष्य-भोज्य माँगे, अथवा बाहर कहीं मार्ग पर गया हुआ पेय माँगे।
english: Or [an agent] should ask the treasonable high official for eatables and edibles, by praise: "Your cook or maker of eatables is excellent"; or, outside, somewhere, having gone on a road, [he should ask] for drink.
notes: Subject and verb for the last clause are carried over ('[he should ask]' in English only). bhakṣa-kāra is literally 'maker of eatables' (cook/confectioner; sense not fixed). bhakṣya-bhojya: literally 'to be eaten (hard food) and to be enjoyed (soft food)'. adhva-gata = 'gone on a road' (traveller).

hindi: उन दोनों को विष से मिलाकर प्रतिस्वादन में उन दोनों को ही उपयोग कराए।
english: Having mixed both of those with poison, at the tasting in return he should make just those two partake.
notes: 'Both of those' are the eatables and the drink of unit 30; 'those two' (tau) are not identified in the line (perhaps the cook and the maker of eatables). pratisvādana is literally 'tasting in return / counter-tasting'; the sense is not spelled out. upa-√yuj caus. is 'make use / partake'.

hindi: उसे प्रसिद्ध करके — "दोनों रसद हैं" — मरवा दे।
english: Having made that known—"[They are] two poisoners"—he should have [them] killed.
notes: rasada = poisoner (glossary 12.2); the Hindi form रसद is fixed by the glossary and clashes with रसद 'supplies' in other books. Object of ghātayet is understood (the two).

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a holy man
of monitor lizard, tortoise, crab and kūṭa

hindi: अथवा सिद्ध के वेश वाला गुप्तचर अभिचार में लगे रहने वाले से ग्रहण कराए — "गोह, कछुआ, केकड़ा और कूट के लक्षण वाले में से किसी एक के भक्षण से तुम मनोरथ पाओगे।"
english: Or the agent in the guise of a holy man should make one given to abhicāra (hostile rites) take [this]: "By eating any one of the marked monitor lizard, tortoise, crab and kūṭa, you will obtain your wishes."
notes: kūṭa is obscure here and left untranslated (the word means 'peak, heap, trick' in general). lakṣaṇya is literally 'bearing marks' (fit/auspicious by marks); the construction 'of the marked ones' is literal and the sense of marks is not explained. grāhayet is literally 'should cause to take' (accept). godhā = monitor lizard (glossary 14.1). abhicāra is kept as a term.

words.gloss: by the failure of the action

hindi: कर्म में लगे हुए को विष से अथवा लोहे के मूसलों से मरवा दे — "कर्म की विफलता से मारा गया।"
english: [He] should have the one who has engaged in the action killed with poison or with iron pestles: "Killed by the failure of the action."
notes: pratipanna is 'accepted / entered upon' (glossary: the one who has accepted); here with karmaṇi: 'engaged in the action'. karma = action (glossary); the action is the one set up in unit 33. vyāpad = failure, mishap. Subject (the agent) not stated.

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a physician
in the compounds of medicine and diet

hindi: अथवा चिकित्सक के वेश वाला गुप्तचर दूष्य के दौरात्मिक अथवा असाध्य रोग को स्थापित करके औषध और आहार के योगों में विष से छले।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a physician, having established a daurātmika (literally 'of evil nature') or incurable disease of the treasonable one, should outwit [him] with poison in the compounds of medicine and diet.
notes: daurātmika is obscure; literally 'of evil nature' (from durātman); no medical sense is claimed. yoga = compound (glossary 14.4) in the medicinal sense. sthāpayitvā 'having established' (that he has the disease). The one outwitted is understood to be the dūṣya.

words.gloss: agents in the guise of cooks and ārālikas

hindi: अथवा सूद और आरालिक के वेश वाले नियुक्त गुप्तचर दूष्य को विष से छलें।
english: Or agents posted in the guise of cooks and ārālikas should outwit the treasonable one with poison.
notes: ārālika is kept as a term (a type of kitchen servant; sense not fixed here). sūda = cook.

hindi: — यह उपनिषद् द्वारा प्रतिषेध है।
english: — such is the restraint by the secret teaching (upaniṣad).
notes: upaniṣad is literally 'secret teaching'; the relation to the later section on secret practices is not claimed. The printed 'upaniṣat' is upaniṣad-/-t by sandhi before p. The opening iti sums up the preceding procedures; it is not rendered 'thus'.

words.gloss: restraint of the treasonable ones of both [kinds]

hindi: किन्तु उभय दूष्यों का प्रतिषेध —
english: But the restraint of the treasonable ones of both [kinds] —
notes: The sentence continues in unit 39 (the sentence is not complete here: 'where the treasonable one is to be restrained...'); GROUPING: unit 38 is an introductory fragment of unit 39. ubhaya-dūṣya is obscure: 'the treasonable ones of both [kinds]' (both being a pair not named in the line); the pair is not specified.

words.gloss: accompanied by weak troops and assassins
of the works of forts, embankments, trade routes, settlement of empty land, mines, forests of materials and of elephants

hindi: जहाँ दूष्य को रोकना हो वहाँ दूष्य को ही दुर्बल सेना और तीक्ष्णों से युक्त करके भेजे — "जाओ, उस दुर्ग या राष्ट्र में सेना खड़ी करो, अथवा हिरण्य; या वल्लभ से हिरण्य ले आओ; या वल्लभ की कन्या को बलपूर्वक ले आओ; या दुर्ग, सेतु, वणिक्-पथ, शून्य-निवेश, खान, द्रव्य और हाथियों के वन के कर्मों में से कोई एक कराओ, अथवा राष्ट्र का पालन या अन्त का पालन; और जो तुम्हें रोके या तुम्हें सहायता न दे, वह बाँधा जाना चाहिए।"
english: Where a treasonable one is to be restrained, there he should send just the treasonable one, accompanied by weak troops and assassins: "Go; in that fort or country raise an army, or gold; or fetch gold from the favourite; or, having seized by force, bring the favourite's daughter; or have any one of the works of forts, embankments, trade routes, settlement of empty land, mines, and forests of materials and of elephants done, or the guarding of the country or of the frontier. And whoever should hinder you, or should not give you help, he is to be bound."

text_flags.why: possible: the closing quotation mark before iti has no opening mark in the e-text; the quoted order seems to begin at gaccha.

notes: Opening quotation mark missing in the e-text (see text_flags); the quoted instruction is taken to start at 'gaccha'. The compound of works is rendered as dvandva; 'dravya-hasti-vana' is read as 'forests of materials and of elephants' (alternative: dravya-vana and hasti-vana, or 'material, elephant, forest'). śūnya-niveśa = settlement of empty (deserted) land. amuṣmin = 'in that' (alternative 'in such-and-such'). vallabha = favourite, here the person of that name in unit 4, not identified further. pratiṣeddhavya 'to be restrained'; pratiṣedhayet (caus.) rendered 'should hinder'. rāṣṭra-pālya/anta-pālya: 'the guarding of the country/frontier' (or 'the post of country-warden/frontier officer').

hindi: वैसे ही दूसरों के लिए भेजे — "अमुक की अविनय को रोकना चाहिए।"
english: Just so, for the others he should send [them]: "The misconduct of so-and-so is to be restrained."
notes: itareṣām is a genitive plural, 'of / for the others'; the object of preṣayet (the dūṣyas as in unit 39) is understood, hence '[them]' in English only. The quoted words are the order given to the one sent. amuṣya = 'of that one / so-and-so'.

words.gram: pres. part. ātm. m. acc. sg. vi-√vad

hindi: इन कलह के स्थानों में अथवा कर्मों के प्रतिघातों में विवाद करते हुए उसे तीक्ष्ण शस्त्र गिराकर छिपे रूप से मार डालें।
english: The assassins, having dropped a weapon, should kill him covertly while he quarrels in these occasions of quarrel or in the obstructions of works.
notes: pātayitvā is literally 'having caused to fall' (dropped a weapon). 'These' refers to the quarrels of the preceding units (the quarrel and obstruction of works, units 39-40). pracchanna 'covertly' (literally 'concealed').

hindi: उस दोष से दूसरों का नियन्त्रण करना चाहिए।
english: By that fault the others are to be controlled.
notes: doṣa is 'fault, offence' here (not the medical sense). The sense is that the offence of the one killed is laid against the others; the line does not say more.

words.gloss: in the boundary-limits of border, field, threshing-floor and house
in injury to goods, implements, crops and vehicles

words.gram: ppp. m. loc. sg. ud-√pad caus.

hindi: नगरों, गाँवों अथवा कुलों के दूष्यों में सीमा, खेत, खलिहान और घर की मर्यादाओं में, द्रव्य, उपकरण, फसल और वाहनों की हिंसा में, अथवा प्रेक्षा, कृत्य और उत्सवों में कलह उत्पन्न होने पर, या तीक्ष्णों द्वारा उत्पन्न कराए जाने पर, तीक्ष्ण शस्त्र गिराकर कहें — "जो इसके साथ कलह करते हैं, उनके साथ ऐसा किया जाता है।"
english: When a quarrel has arisen among the treasonable ones of towns, villages or families—over the boundary-limits of border, field, threshing-floor and house, in injury to goods, implements, crops and vehicles, and at shows, functions and festivals—or has been produced by assassins, the assassins, having dropped a weapon, should say: "Thus are they treated who quarrel with this one."

text_flags.why: the colon looks like a misprint for the closing quotation mark before iti; the opening mark stands before evaṃ.

notes: The locative absolute 'samutpanne kalahe ... utpādite' governs the whole list. 'In the boundary-limits of ...' is literal for sīmā-...-maryādā (the sense is disputes over boundaries); prekṣā 'show / spectacle'; kṛtya 'function / rite'. kriyante (passive of √kṛ) is rendered 'they are treated' (literally 'are made'); the sense of the saying is not spelled out. 'amunā' = 'by/with this one'.

hindi: उस दोष से दूसरों का नियन्त्रण करना चाहिए।
english: By that fault the others are to be controlled.
notes: Same words as units 42 and 46.

hindi: अथवा जिन दूष्यों के कलह की जड़ें जम गई हों, उनके खेत, खलिहान और घरों में आग लगाकर, तथा बन्धु-सम्बन्धियों में या वाहनों में तीक्ष्ण शस्त्र गिराकर, वैसे ही कहें — "हम इसके द्वारा लगाए गए हैं।"
english: Or, of those treasonable ones whose quarrels have taken root, the assassins, having set fire to their fields, threshing-floors and houses, and having dropped a weapon among kinsmen and relations or in vehicles, should say in just the same way: "We have been employed by this one."
notes: jāta-mūla is literally 'with roots arisen' (deep-rooted). The placement of 'bandhu-sambandhiṣu vāhaneṣu vā' is taken with 'śastraṃ pātayitvā' (as in unit 43); it could also go with ādīpayitvā ('set fire among kinsmen or in vehicles'). 'In just the same way' = as in unit 43.

hindi: उस दोष से दूसरों का नियन्त्रण करना चाहिए।
english: By that fault the others are to be controlled.
notes: Same words as units 42 and 44.

words.gloss: the treasonable ones of fort and country

hindi: अथवा गुप्तचर दुर्ग और राष्ट्र के दूष्यों को एक-दूसरे का आवेशनिक बनवाएँ।
english: Or secret agents should have the treasonable ones of the fort and of the country made āveśanikas of each other.
notes: āveśanika is obscure and kept untranslated (from ā-√viś 'enter'; a 'guest, lodger' sense is possible but not fixed here). kārayeyuḥ 'should have made'.

hindi: वहाँ रसद विष दें।
english: There the poisoners should give poison.
notes: rasada = poisoner (glossary); the Hindi रसद is the glossary form and could be misread as 'supplies'. rasa = poison.

hindi: उस दोष से दूसरों का नियन्त्रण करना चाहिए।
english: By that fault the others are to be controlled.
notes: Same words as units 42, 44 and 46.

words.gloss: of a treasonable chief of the country

hindi: अथवा भिक्षुकी दूष्य राष्ट्र-मुख्य को — "दूष्य राष्ट्र-मुख्य की पत्नी, पुत्रवधू या पुत्री कामना करती है" — गुप्त रूप से उकसाए।
english: Or a female mendicant should instigate secretly a treasonable chief of the country: "The wife, daughter-in-law or daughter of a treasonable chief of the country desires [you]."
notes: The object of kāmayate is not stated ('[you]' supplied in English only). The speaker speaks of a second dūṣya chief (the one named in the genitive) to the first; the line gives no further detail. rāṣṭra-mukhya = chief of the country; the case of the compound members is not marked.

words.gloss: of the one who has accepted

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने वाले का आभरण लेकर स्वामी को दिखलाए — "वह तुम्हारा मुख्य यौवन के मद में चूर पत्नी, पुत्रवधू या पुत्री पर मन लगाए है।"
english: Having taken an ornament of the one who has accepted, [she] should show it to the master: "That chief of yours, elated with youth, has his mind on a wife, daughter-in-law or daughter."
notes: svāmin is 'master, lord' here; it is not the king of the seven prakṛtis (glossary), and the line does not say whose master. The subject (the female mendicant of unit 50) is understood. 'te' (of yours) could also qualify the women ('your wife ...'). abhi-√man with accusative is literally 'to think upon' (covet is an alternative sense); the woman's side (whose wife) is not stated.

hindi: उन दोनों का कलह — "रात में" — यह समान है।
english: The quarrel of those two: "at night"—[this] is the same [as before].
notes: Elliptical cross-reference like unit 13: 'at night' recalls the night scene of unit 10; the line does not say which parts are the same. iti closes the quoted words and is not rendered 'thus'.

words.gloss: among the treasonable ones who have submitted with their army

hindi: किन्तु सेना सहित समर्पण करने वाले दूष्यों में — युवराज अथवा सेनापति कुछ अपकार करके चला गया हो तो आक्रमण करे।
english: But among the treasonable ones who have submitted with their army—the heir-apparent or the commander of the army, having done some harm and gone away, may attack.
notes: The lone '-' in the e-text is taken as a dash of punctuation. The sentence is elliptical: the prince or commander who has fled after some wrong acts as the one who attacks (vikrameta, literally 'may march / display valour'). daṇḍa-upanata = one submitting with his army (glossary 12.5).

words.gloss: treasonable ones who have submitted with their army
accompanied by weak troops and assassins

hindi: तब राजा सेना सहित समर्पण करने वाले दूष्यों को ही दुर्बल सेना और तीक्ष्णों से युक्त करके भेजे — सभी योग समान हैं।
english: Then the king should send just those treasonable ones who have submitted with their army, accompanied by weak troops and assassins—all the contrivances are the same.
notes: yoga = secret contrivance (glossary 12.4). The closing iti marks the end of the rule and is not rendered 'thus'. 'all the contrivances are the same' = the same as the earlier procedures.

hindi: और उनके अनुक्षियत पुत्रों में जो निर्विकार है, वह पिता का दाय पाए।
english: And among their sons who are anukṣiyat [obscure], the one who is unchanged should obtain his father's inheritance.
notes: anukṣiyatsu is obscure and possibly corrupt (a locative plural of a present participle anu-√kṣi; the sense 'wasting away / remaining behind' is uncertain); left untranslated with no emendation. nirvikāra is literally 'without alteration'. Confidence is low.

words.gloss: with the fault of men cast away

hindi: इस प्रकार इसका राज्य, जिसका पुरुष-दोष दूर कर दिया गया है, इसके पुत्र-पौत्रों का अनुसरण करता है।
english: Thus his kingdom, with the fault of men cast away, follows his sons and grandsons.
notes: anuvartate with the accusative is literally 'follows'; the sense is that the kingdom passes down to them. puruṣa-doṣa = the fault of men (their faults), not specified further.

hindi: अपने पक्ष में या शत्रु-पक्ष में चुपचाप दण्ड का प्रयोग करे, भविष्य में और वर्तमान में, क्षमावान् और अशंकित रहकर।
english: A forbearing, unsuspected [king] should silently apply punishment against his own party or the enemy's party, both in the future and in the present.
notes: Verse (anuṣṭubh, 8+8 per line; the metre agrees with the printed text). The subject is not stated ('[king]' in English only). daṇḍa = punishment here ('force' is the alternative, as the fourth upāya); aviśaṅkita = 'unsuspected' (alternative: 'without hesitation'). āyatyām ca tadātve ca: 'both in the future and in the present'.
